description: Shared Renovate settings for vEXOULZ repos. Extend with "github>vEXOULZ/conventions//renovate/default".

customManagers.description: The conventions version a repo pins in .conventions.toml

packageRules.description: The pin and every reusable workflow move together, in one PR. It fails `conventions / check` until someone runs `conventions sync` on the branch and pushes the result.
prBodyNotes: Run `conventions sync` on this branch at the new version and push the result; until then `conventions / check` fails, as it should.

packageRules.description: Node is set by conventions (`.nvmrc` is synced, `engines.node` is checked), so it moves with a conventions release, not a Renovate PR.
See above: `engines.node` follows the conventions Node version.
Python is set by conventions too (`.python-version` is checked): no `.python-version` or `requires-python` PRs, and the `python` base image keeps its minor version.
See above: `requires-python` follows the conventions Python version.
See above: the `python` image only gets patch and digest updates.
